text.text: Both flights used: 35°, 35 m/s, g = 9.8 m/s², 2 kg, launch height = 10 m.
Inspect either flight to explore its original samples on the canvas, graphs, and data table.
Both bars start at zero and share a scale within each measure. Change is air drag minus no drag; percentages use no drag as the baseline.
Values are rounded to three decimal places.
Air drag opposes motion in still air with a fixed drag coefficient.
